previous_statement: Universal constant and radius ledger. Set K_1:=max{1,L,c_0^cb,C_proj*L,C_np*L,C_pair*L,C_co*(c_0^cb+1)} and e_call_1:=min{e_env,e_co/(c_0^cb+1),e_proj/L,e_np/L,e_pair/L,e_1/K_1}.
